answer: Because the age is read from the kernel checkpoint rather than self-declared, the comet audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm as a result means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. An identity must be at least 2 epochs old on the onyx ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
